Per-clause tuples with named boundaries make each verification increment look smaller than it is: proving one subsystem yields a claim scoped to_platform(p), not a claim about the kernel. Honest reporting therefore understates the verified core's growth at every step, and the incentive to aggregate into a friendlier composite number is strongest for the people doing the work.

```day-tension
{"between":["honest-assurance","verified-core-grows"]}
```
